meta.name: understand-figma
meta.description: Analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) with a kind:"design" dashboard.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析 Figma 文件并生成交互式设计知识图谱
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从 Figma 设计稿中提取结构化信息
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Figma files and generate an interactive design knowledge graph
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to extract structured information from Figma designs

howto.what: 当你给出 Figma 文件链接或密钥，Claude 会先检查是否已设置 Figma 访问令牌（FIGMA_TOKEN），然后用官方接口抓取设计数据，生成包含页面、组件、设计令牌等信息的交互式知识图谱，并自动启动仪表盘。
howto.when: 当用户提供 Figma 文件链接或文件 key 时触发；若未设置 FIGMA_TOKEN，Claude 会先提示设置。也可附带 --language 参数指定语言。

say.text: 请分析这个 Figma 文件链接
say.note: Claude 会抓取设计数据并生成知识图谱。

say.text: 用 understand-figma 分析文件密钥 abc123
say.note: 按密钥解析文件并展示组件结构。

say.text: 分析设计稿，图谱用中文生成
say.note: 附加语言参数，结果以中文呈现。

howto.what_en: With this skill, given a Figma file URL or key, Claude checks for a FIGMA_TOKEN, fetches design data via the official API, builds an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, components, tokens), and launches the dashboard.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a Figma file URL or key, optionally with --language. If FIGMA_TOKEN is missing, Claude asks to set it first.

say_en.note: Fetches design data and generates a knowledge graph.

say_en.text: Use understand-figma on file key abc123
say_en.note: Parses the file and shows component structure.

say_en.text: Analyze my design, graph in Chinese
say_en.note: Adds language parameter; results in Chinese.
